meta.title: EduLaunch
meta.description: An education and career planning platform based on official information.

directory.title: Universities & programmes
directory.intro: Find programmes by university, field and level. Records marked "sample" are not real requirements.
directory.sampleNote: includes sample data • official sources not yet verified
directory.emptyBody: Try choosing "All" in one of the filters.
directory.errorTitle: The programme list could not be loaded
directory.errorBody: This part is temporarily unavailable. Please try again shortly.

detail.noRequirement: Entry requirements for this programme are not available yet.
detail.sourceSample: Sample record: not verified. Do not use it for real decisions.
detail.sourcePublished: Published after review by two admins.
detail.evidenceIntro: The source sentences each requirement is based on.

requirements.creditsDetail: At least {count} subjects at grade {grade} or better

soon.title: Coming soon
soon.body: This part is not ready yet. It will be added in a later step.

side.title: One account, one journey.
side.body: Logging in is needed for your personal tools.

signInPage.title: Welcome back
signInPage.heroBody: Your academic profile, interests and roadmap in one journey.
signInPage.terms: By logging in, you agree to the EduLaunch terms of use and privacy notice.

signUpPage.title: Create your EduLaunch account
signUpPage.intro: For secondary school students and after SPM, pre-university and Diploma.
signUpPage.name: Name
signUpPage.consent: I have read the privacy notice and terms of use.

forgotPage.title: Recover your account
forgotPage.intro: Enter your email to request a recovery link.
forgotPage.afterBody: If this email is registered, we send a link to set a new password.

inboxPage.title: Check your inbox
inboxPage.intro: We have sent a link to your email. Check your spam folder too.
inboxPage.notReceivedBody: Wait a minute before asking again. An expired link can be replaced with a new request.

newPasswordPage.title: Set a new password
newPasswordPage.intro: Choose a new password for your account.

errors.passwordShort: The password needs at least 8 characters.
errors.consent: Tick the consent box to continue.
errors.invalidCredentials: The email or password is not correct.
errors.emailTaken: This email already has an account. Try logging in.
errors.emailNotConfirmed: Confirm your email first with the link we sent.
errors.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Please try again shortly.
errors.samePassword: The new password must be different from the old one.
errors.linkExpired: This link has expired or was already used. Request a new one below.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again shortly.

onboarding.title: Start from where you are
onboarding.intro: Your account is ready. Choose the situation closest to yours — it helps us suggest a first step. You do not need to pick a career or have SPM results to start.
onboarding.question: What is your education level now?
onboarding.questionHint: We adapt the results form, modules and suggestions to your level. You can change it later.
onboarding.sideBody: You can change this any time in your Profile.

form1_3.title: Form 1–3
form1_3.body: Discover your interests, enter school exam grades and choose a Form 4 stream.

form4_5.title: Form 4–5
form4_5.body: SPM subjects, current and target grades, Merit Lab simulation.

after_spm.title: After SPM
after_spm.body: Enter your actual SPM results and check eligibility.

after_preu.title: After STPM / Matriculation / Foundation / A-Level
after_preu.body: CGPA, MUET and subject grades for degree programmes.

after_diploma.title: After Diploma
after_diploma.body: CGPA and diploma field for related degrees.

admin.title: Admin console
admin.body: You are logged in as an admin. The admin console is being built and will come in a later step.

footer.disclaimer: Disclaimer: EduLaunch is an independent platform. Programme information refers to official sources from institutions and related agencies; please confirm with them before applying. EduLaunch does not guarantee an offer of admission.
